purpose: Extend generated 3DFACE DXF callback checks to common entity presentation fields and both consumer sinks.

authority.relevantFields: 3DFACE corners (groups 10-13) are WCS points; group 70 contains the four invisible-edge flags. The generated test additionally exercises common entity fields through the existing callback projection.

scopeLimit: Generated same-library DXF callback transport only. It does not establish independent interoperability, DWG producer semantics, or native rendering; FreeCAD's importer is separately observed as not supporting 3DFACE.
claimEffect: No format or consumer support claim changes.
